rules.matching: Most-specific path pattern owns a file; exact paths override directory patterns. Existing upstream files remain upstream-owned unless explicitly listed as integration seams.
rules.parallel_work: Workers own disjoint assigned component families; do not overwrite another worker's changes. Shared files have one integrator.
rules.generation: Generated targets require matching recorded target hashes before replacement; manual targets require explicit reconciliation.
rules.runtime_state: Runtime project data is user-owned and not generator output.
